evidence.source: Guarded Production rollout run 31475806882 applied contract 158 from exact main fd109e49d8d34526ec6e28576a4c031191fcd2c4, after its own API check that backup run 31473742437 and rehearsal run 31475471473 had both concluded success, and after its dry run matched exactly one migration with nothing above the pinned target. Contract 158 is DESTRUCTIVE by check-migration-additive.mjs — get_league_preview is dropped and recreated because its return type narrows, which create or replace cannot do — so the checker ran as a report rather than a gate, and the backup-and-rehearsal pair stands in its place. An independent read-only query then confirmed 158 rows ending 20260811000000_invite_code_hardening; gen_invite_code() returning TWELVE characters from the rejection-sampled CSPRNG; bonus_competitions_invite_code_shape and invite_code_registry_shape both reading ^[A-Z0-9]{6,16}$ and resolve_invite_code widened with them, without which every private competition creation would raise check_violation and every newly issued code would read as unknown; get_league_preview narrowed to TABLE(name text, is_member boolean) with the id, member count and owner name gone, which is the confirmation oracle SEC-001 named; the league_invite_probe limit charged BEFORE the lookup in both the preview and join_league; that function's game-membership gate still present, which an earlier draft of the migration had silently dropped; rotate_league_invite_code executable by authenticated and by no anonymous role; and the Euro publication state still hidden. Nothing player-owned moved across the migration and no invite code was rewritten: 1 auth user, 1 profile, 3 tournaments, 56 teams, 51 matches, 36 match predictions, 1 league, 1 league member, 10 competitions, 578 season fixtures, 1 league invite code still six characters and 1 shared-registry row, all unchanged. Application promotion remains separately controlled and is NOT claimed by this record.
